title: 雨上がりの、名前のない猫と
author: 渡会 はる

en.title: After the Rain, and the Nameless Cat
en.premise: Twin sisters Tsumugi and Nagi live with a rare disease that is slowly stripping them of their ability to speak. Their quiet daily lives begin to shift when a 'nameless cat' suddenly appears in their garden. Amidst fading memories and family bonds torn apart by illness, they discover a small, flickering warmth. A story of finding the strength to take a step toward tomorrow while embracing the pain of loss.

zh.title: 雨过天晴，与那只无名之猫
zh.premise: 身患罕见疾病、正逐渐失去言语能力的双胞胎姐妹——紬与凪。某天，一只出现在庭院里的“无名之猫”，让她们平静的日常生活开始悄然发生动摇。在被疾病撕裂的家族羁绊与逐渐消逝的记忆中，她们寻觅到了微小的温暖。这是一个在接纳丧失之痛的同时，努力摸索迈向明日之步的故事。
